US.name: State and local election offices
US.note: Each state counts and certifies its own results. Media race calls, including AP's, are not used.

boundaries.name: US Census Bureau, 119th Congress cartographic boundaries
boundaries.note: Boundaries in force for the 2024 election. Mid-decade redraws for 2026 are not included yet.

CA.name: Elections Canada
CA.note: Public results download refreshed through the night. Returning officers validate the count.

boundaries.name: Elections Canada, federal electoral districts (2023 Representation Order)

BR.name: Superior Electoral Court (TSE)
BR.note: TSE publishes results as public JSON. Not connected for now.

AR.name: Dirección Nacional Electoral (DINE)
AR.note: The final count is the electoral courts' (Cámara Nacional Electoral).

GB.name: Returning officers' declarations
GB.note: Each seat is declared at its count. There is no official central feed; PA Media licenses the real-time data.

boundaries.name: Office for National Statistics, Westminster constituencies (July 2024)
boundaries.note: Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0. Contains OS data © Crown copyright and database right 2024.

ES.name: Ministerio del Interior
ES.note: The Junta Electoral's scrutiny is the final official result.

FR.name: Ministère de l'Intérieur
FR.note: Election-night estimations from pollsters are not used.

boundaries.name: Contours des circonscriptions législatives, data.gouv.fr
boundaries.note: Built from Ministry of the Interior polling-station data. Shows the 539 metropolitan constituencies; overseas and expatriate seats are not drawn.

DE.name: Die Bundeswahlleiterin
DE.note: Open XML and CSV published as each constituency finishes counting. TV projections are not used.

boundaries.name: Die Bundeswahlleiterin, Wahlkreise for the 2025 Bundestag
boundaries.note: © Die Bundeswahlleiterin, Wiesbaden 2024. © GeoBasis-DE / BKG 2024. Shows the 299 constituencies; the other seats are filled from party lists.

AU.name: Australian Electoral Commission
AU.note: AEC media feed over FTP, updated every 90 seconds. Divisional Returning Officers declare each seat.

boundaries.name: Australian Bureau of Statistics, Commonwealth Electoral Divisions 2025

IN.name: Election Commission of India
IN.note: Returning officers declare each constituency. No public API.

boundaries.name: DataMeet, parliamentary constituencies
boundaries.note: Assam and Jammu and Kashmir show boundaries from before the 2023 delimitation.

JP.name: Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications
JP.note: Prefectural election committees count. There is no official real-time feed; election-night calls are media projections and are not used.

boundaries.name: japan-choropleth, House of Representatives districts (2022)
boundaries.note: Not an official government file; compiled from public-domain data. Shows the 289 single-member districts; the other seats are proportional.

MX.name: Instituto Nacional Electoral (INE)
MX.note: PREP is preliminary; the district computations are official. The quick count is a statistical sample and is not used.

KR.name: National Election Commission
KR.note: NEC's open API is not real-time on election day.

ID.name: General Elections Commission (KPU)
ID.note: The Sirekap real count is unofficial and private quick counts are not used.

ZA.name: Electoral Commission of South Africa (IEC)
ZA.note: The IEC offers a real-time results API to registered third parties.

TR.name: Supreme Election Council (YSK)
TR.note: Agencies relay figures on the night; only YSK announces results.

NL.name: Kiesraad
NL.note: The Kiesraad certifies weeks later. Election-night municipal tallies are gathered by ANP under licence.

AT.name: Federal Ministry of the Interior
AT.note: Provisional results on election night; postal votes are added in the following days.

PT.name: National Elections Commission (CNE)
PT.note: The Ministry of Internal Administration publishes provisional results on election night; the general count is official.

SE.name: Swedish Election Authority (Valmyndigheten)
SE.note: A preliminary count on election night; the final count by the county administrative boards follows within days.

IE.name: Returning officers and the Electoral Commission
IE.note: Each constituency is counted separately by single transferable vote over one or more days; there is no official central live feed.

boundaries.name: Tailte Éireann, Dáil constituencies (2023 boundaries)
boundaries.note: © Tailte Éireann. The 43 constituencies used from the 2024 election, simplified for display.

NO.name: Norwegian Directorate of Elections
NO.note: Publishes the count on valgresultat.no as votes are counted.

NZ.name: Electoral Commission
NZ.note: Publishes the preliminary count on election night and the official result, including special votes, about three weeks later.

RU.name: Central Election Commission of the Russian Federation
RU.note: Its national totals include votes cast in Crimea and Sevastopol since 2016, and in occupied parts of Donetsk, Luhansk, Zaporizhzhia and Kherson oblasts since 2024.

PH.name: Commission on Elections
PH.note: Congress, as the national board of canvassers, proclaims the president and vice president; COMELEC canvasses the Senate and party-list votes.

CL.name: Electoral Service of Chile
CL.note: Servel publishes the count on election night; the Election Certification Court (Tricel) certifies the final results.

BO.name: Plurinational Electoral Organ
BO.note: Its Supreme Electoral Tribunal (TSE) publishes the official count (cómputo).

CO.name: National Civil Registry (Registraduría Nacional del Estado Civil)
CO.note: Counts the votes and publishes the preliminary count on election night; the National Electoral Council (CNE) oversees elections and declares the final results.

PE.name: National Office of Electoral Processes (ONPE)
PE.note: Organises the vote and publishes the count; the National Jury of Elections (JNE) oversees the process and proclaims the results.

CZ.name: Czech Statistical Office
CZ.note: Publishes the official results on volby.cz.

SK.name: Statistical Office of the Slovak Republic
SK.note: Publishes the official results on volby.statistics.sk and volbysr.sk.

HU.name: National Election Office
HU.note: Nemzeti Választási Iroda publishes the count on vtr.valasztas.hu as votes are counted; postal votes from abroad are added in the following days.

GR.name: Ministry of the Interior
GR.note: Publishes the official results on ekloges.ypes.gr.

BE.name: Federal Public Service Interior
BE.note: Its elections directorate publishes the official results on resultatselection.belgium.be.

RO.name: Permanent Electoral Authority
RO.note: Publishes turnout and the count on prezenta.roaep.ro as votes are counted; the Central Electoral Bureau (BEC) declares the final results.

DK.name: Statistics Denmark
DK.note: Publishes Denmark proper's count by constituency on dst.dk/valg; the Faroe Islands and Greenland publish their own.

FI.name: Ministry of Justice
FI.note: Publishes the count on its Election Information and Results Service as votes are counted.

CH.name: Federal Statistical Office
CH.note: Publishes the National Council and Council of States results on elections.admin.ch as the cantons count them.

UA.name: Central Election Commission of Ukraine
UA.note: Publishes the official count and final results. Under martial law, in force since February 2022, no national election can be held.

maps: Country and state outlines: Natural Earth and world-atlas (public domain).
